question: ap1
prompt:
Research question: "What analyses or measurements would best test whether AP-1 acts as a cellular memory mechanism?"

Propose 5 distinct, concrete ideas (analyses, measurements, or experiments) that a research lab could pursue to address this question. For each idea give a short title and a description of one or two sentences.

ideas.title: Transient stimulus with long-term chromatin accessibility tracking
ideas.description: Expose cells (e.g., fibroblasts, macrophages, or keratinocytes) to a defined, transient AP-1-activating stimulus (such as TPA, injury, or inflammatory cues), then perform ATAC-seq/CUT&Tag for AP-1 factors (FOS, JUN) and H3K27ac at time points from hours to weeks after washout. Persistent AP-1-bound accessible sites after stimulus removal, relative to naive controls, would indicate memory.

ideas.title: Acute AP-1 perturbation (degron/CRISPRi/dominant-negative) during priming versus recall
ideas.description: Use dTAG/AID degrons or dominant-negative A-FOS to deplete AP-1 only during the priming phase, only during the memory/maintenance phase, or only during the re-stimulation phase. If memory requires AP-1 for establishment but not maintenance (or vice versa), this dissects whether AP-1 is the initiator, the carrier, or merely a reader of the memory.

ideas.title: Re-stimulation (primed vs naive) transcriptional response assays
ideas.description: Compare primed and naive cells upon second stimulation using RNA-seq, nascent transcription (PRO-seq/TT-seq), and live reporters, testing for faster/stronger induction of AP-1 target genes. Correlate magnitude of the recall response with prior AP-1 occupancy at the corresponding enhancers to link AP-1 binding to functional memory.

ideas.title: Single-cell multiome and lineage-tracing of memory inheritance
ideas.description: Apply single-cell RNA+ATAC (and clonal barcoding) to primed populations across cell divisions to test whether AP-1 motif accessibility/activity is stably inherited by daughter cells and whether sister cells share memory states. Pair with live-cell imaging of endogenous tagged FOS/JUN dynamics to see if heritable differences in AP-1 level or dynamics predict later responses.

ideas.title: Locus-specific causal editing of AP-1 sites and chromatin-state readouts
ideas.description: Mutate or CRISPR-block individual AP-1 motifs at candidate memory enhancers (or tether activators/repressors via dCas9) and measure whether priming-induced accessibility, histone marks, 3D contacts (Micro-C/HiChIP), and recall expression are lost. Also test whether pioneer-associated partners (e.g., BAF/SWI-SNF, p300) at these sites are required, distinguishing AP-1 as a causal memory element from a correlate.
